knowledge:
- key_parameters: bam_files=Character vector of paths to mapped RNA-seq reads in BAM format ;; probe_mapping_file=Path to the probe sequence mapping file (*_mapping.txt) ;; cdf_name=Optional name of the CDF package; if omitted, it is inferred from the mapping filename ;; cluster=Optional cluster object created by parallel::makeCluster for parallel processing ;; output_eset=Logical; if TRUE (default), returns an ExpressionSet, otherwise returns a data frame ;; paired_ended_reads=Logical; set to TRUE for paired-end RNA-seq data to avoid treating mate reads as independent (default FALSE) ;; ignore_strand=Logical; set to FALSE for strand-specific RNA-seq protocols (default TRUE) ;; sum.method=Summarization method, either "rpa" (default, recommended) or "rma"
- alternatives: sum.method="rpa" vs sum.method="rma"=RPA is the default and preferred method because it yields slightly higher RNA-seq–microarray comparability when both datasets are processed with RPA. RMA is supported for legacy compatibility (it was the default before version 1.7.1).
- when_to_use: Use this package when you want to perform joint analysis, integration, or direct comparison between RNA-seq datasets and microarray datasets by processing the RNA-seq data through microarray-like probe summarization.
- pitfalls: Ensure BAM files contain reads mapped to no more than 1 location (e.g., using TopHat's --max-multihits 1 option) ;; Ensure the installed Custom CDF package version matches the version of the downloaded _mapping.txt file to avoid missing probe sequence errors ;; For paired-end data, you must explicitly set paired_ended_reads=TRUE ;; For strand-specific RNA-seq, you must set ignore_strand=FALSE ;; When manually creating mapping files, remember that Bowtie reports 0-based start coordinates, but prebs mapping files require 1-based coordinates (add 1 to the start positions).

workflows.name: custom_cdf_expression
workflows.intent: Calculate gene-level expression values from RNA-seq BAM files using a Custom CDF mapping.
input: HGU133Plus2_Hs_ENSG_mapping.txt (Custom CDF probe sequence mapping file)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the prebs and prebsdata libraries ;; 2. Define paths to BAM files and the Custom CDF mapping file ;; 3. Run calc_prebs to compute gene-level expression values ;; 4. Extract and view the expression matrix using exprs()
workflows.code:
library(prebs)
library(prebsdata)
bam_file1 <- system.file(file.path("sample_bam_files", "input1.bam"), 
                         package="prebsdata")
bam_file2 <- system.file(file.path("sample_bam_files", "input2.bam"), 
                         package="prebsdata")
bam_files <- c(bam_file1, bam_file2)
custom_cdf_mapping1 <- system.file(file.path("custom-cdf", 
    "HGU133Plus2_Hs_ENSG_mapping.txt"), package="prebsdata")
prebs_values <- calc_prebs(bam_files, custom_cdf_mapping1)
head(exprs(prebs_values))

workflows.name: manufacturer_cdf_expression
workflows.intent: Calculate probe set-level expression values from RNA-seq BAM files using a manufacturer's CDF mapping.
input: HGU133Plus2_mapping.txt (manufacturer's CDF probe sequence mapping file)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the prebs and prebsdata libraries ;; 2. Define paths to BAM files and the manufacturer's CDF mapping file ;; 3. Run calc_prebs specifying the manufacturer's mapping file and optionally the CDF package name ;; 4. Extract and view the probe set expression matrix using exprs()
workflows.code:
library(prebs)
library(prebsdata)
bam_file1 <- system.file(file.path("sample_bam_files", "input1.bam"), 
                         package="prebsdata")
bam_file2 <- system.file(file.path("sample_bam_files", "input2.bam"), 
                         package="prebsdata")
bam_files <- c(bam_file1, bam_file2)
manufacturer_cdf_mapping <- system.file(file.path("manufacturer-cdf", 
    "HGU133Plus2_mapping.txt"), package="prebsdata")
prebs_values <- calc_prebs(bam_files, manufacturer_cdf_mapping, 
                           cdf_name="hgu133plus2cdf")
head(exprs(prebs_values))

workflows.name: create_probe_mapping
workflows.intent: Generate a custom probe sequence mapping file for a microarray platform using its Bioconductor probe package and genomic alignment coordinates.
input: hgu133plus2probe (Bioconductor probe package for the platform)
output_probe_mappings.map (Bowtie alignment output file of probe sequences mapped to the genome)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the platform's probe package and convert it to a data frame ;; 2. Filter out control probes (AFFX) and compute probe IDs using xy2indices ;; 3. Export probe sequences to a text file for alignment ;; 4. Read the genomic alignment map file and adjust 0-based coordinates to 1-based ;; 5. Merge the alignment coordinates with the probe information and write the final mapping file
workflows.code:
library("hgu133plus2probe")
probes <- as.data.frame(hgu133plus2probe)
head(probes)
library("affy")
probes <- probes[substr(probes$Probe.Set.Name,1,4) != "AFFX",]
probes$Probe.ID <- xy2indices(probes$x, probes$y, cdf="hgu133plus2cdf")
write.table(probes, file="probes.txt", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE)
probe_mappings <- read.table("output_probe_mappings.map")
colnames(probe_mappings) <- c("Probe.ID", "strand", 
                              "chr", "start", "seq", "match", "multiple")
probe_mappings$start <- probe_mappings$start + 1 
probes <- read.table("probes.txt", head=TRUE)
probes <- merge(probes, probe_mappings)
output_table <- data.frame(Probe.Set.Name=probes$Probe.Set.Name, 
    Chr=probes$chr, Chr.Strand=probes$strand, Chr.From=probes$start, 
    Probe.X=probes$x, Probe.Y=probes$y, Affy.Probe.Set.Name=probes$Probe.Set.Name)
write.table(output_table, file="HGU133Plus2_mapping.txt", 
            quote=FALSE, sep="\t", row.names=FALSE)
